current: 04-SEP (twentieth pass): THE SHARED TERMINAL CONSTRUCTION RE-POINTED, on a measurement rather than an argument. Its maintenance charge escalates book depreciation over HALF the useful life, which is the right identity ONLY under uniform vintages — and the error scales with inflation, so it is nearly invisible in a pegged market and severe in Egypt. MEASURED ON EGCH from its own audited note 6, read by OCR off the pixels (48-character text layer across 48 pages) and footed FOUR ways against figures the study had already committed independently: depreciable gross cost EGP 17.02bn over a charge of 771.2mn implies a 22.07-year life, while accumulated depreciation of 3.44bn over the same charge puts the average age at 4.45 YEARS against the 11.04 half the life assumes, with only 1.3% of the base fully depreciated. At 7% the escalators are 1.352 and 2.110 — the proxy over-charges by 56%, charges 144% of terminal profit and drives EGCH's equity NEGATIVE, on a company that has just spent EGP 20bn on a new plant. terminal_value.py now takes a MEASURED age where it is supplied and sourced (accumulated depreciation over the year's own charge is exactly the charge-weighted average age under straight-line — an identity, not an estimate) and the record SAYS WHICH of the two it used. THE FALLBACK IS BYTE-IDENTICAL, so no committed answer moves and no ratchet grows. THE DIRECTION IS NOT UNIVERSAL and that is why it had to be measured: EGCH 4.45 against 11.04, RIYADHCABLE 23.17 against 17.88, EMPOWER 10.11 against 14.05 — one far younger, one older, one younger [L-326]. RIYADHCABLE and EMPOWER both take the measured age the same day and move in OPPOSITE directions — -1.03% and +1.33% — which is the whole argument for measuring it rather than correcting in one direction.

Run on all five records: 9 adopt, 37 watch, 42 none out of 88 drivers. WHY THE RATIO MISLED, WHICH IS THE USEFUL HALF: the retired charge is g x IC, a NET growth charge on an IMPLIED capital base (terminal NOPAT / a blended terminal ROIC = 4,483 against a replacement base of 8,693), with maintenance ASSUMED EQUAL TO DEPRECIATION and cancelled out of the arithmetic; book D&A is a GROSS charge on the historical base; the corrected construction charges maintenance GROSS at replacement cost and ADDS BOOK D&A BACK. On this name replacement maintenance is only 16% above book D&A (394 vs 340) while the implied base is HALF the replacement base — so the corrected NET charge is 63 against the retired 90, i.e. 0.71x, and the value rises. THREE DIFFERENT DEFINITIONS, ONE RATIO.
